items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to sensation versus perception and the monocular and binocular cues we use to judge distance.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Radio 4 series covering visual science and perceptual research — relevant episodes explore how the brain constructs depth and distance.

items.title: Sensation, Perception, Monocular and Binocular Depth Cues — AQA GCSE
items.description: AQA-specific revision video covering all the monocular cues (texture gradient, relative size, overlap) and binocular cues on the GCSE spec.

items.title: How Your Brain Sees Depth (Monocular vs Binocular Cues)
items.description: Explains retinal disparity and stereopsis alongside the monocular depth cues with visual demonstrations.

items.title: Sensation and Perception: Crash Course Psychology #5
items.description: Introduces the distinction between sensation and perception and how depth perception works — ideal background for this lesson.

items.title: Inside the Human Body — BBC
items.description: BBC series featuring the visual system and how the brain processes sensory information into perceptual experiences.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Visual Perception Theory
items.description: Overview of depth cues, sensation versus perception and the key perceptual theories — essential reading for this unit.

items.title: Monocular Depth Cues SHORT Revision — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: Quick-fire video revision of all monocular depth cues with mnemonics — useful for exam recall practice.
